verdict.rationale: DGX B200 documentation lists multiple management surfaces (Web UI, Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM, plus CLI tools like nvidia-smi) suggesting some parity between UI and programmatic control, but there is no explicit claim or evidence that every UI-accessible action (e.g., Mission Control dashboards, health monitoring alerts) is fully replicable via API/CLI. Missing for 10: an explicit API reference or documentation confirming full feature parity with the web/BMC UI, and independent confirmation that all administrative actions can be scripted/automated without the UI.
